en: Black‑and‑white view down a wide main street in a late‑19th/early‑20th‑century town. Multi‑story brick commercial buildings line both sides, with striped awnings over storefronts. Horse‑drawn wagons and carriages are on the unpaved street, and people walk along the sidewalks. Tall wooden utility poles with crossarms run down both sides. Visible storefront signs advertise farm machinery, agricultural implements, and paints.
